meta.title: Asahi Prime Ski Resort
meta.description: ~20 min from Shiojiri IC — 22 snow guns, compact layout, no getting lost. The perfect family ski area in Asahi village for first snow play and ski debut.

hero.eyebrow: Asahi, Nagano · ~20 min from Shiojiri IC
hero.title:
Asahi Prime
Ski Resort
hero.tagline: The perfect and safest private slope for your family's very first ski debut and snow experience.

transit.title:
~20 min from Shiojiri IC,
roads with less snow stress.
transit.lead: About 15–18 km (~20–28 min drive) from Shiojiri IC on the Nagano Expressway. Approach roads tend to carry less snow than deep mountain routes — easier for families uneasy on winter roads. Matsumoto Airport is about 19 minutes by car. Known as the closest ski hill to Matsumoto and Shiojiri cities.
transit.imgAlt: Winter drive toward Asahi village — access road from Shiojiri IC to Asahi Prime

primary.title: Compact · hard to get separated
primary.lead: Everything clusters around Cartet Hall base — far lower risk of families splitting up than at huge resorts. Parents can watch kids from the lodge. A compact layout built for safe beginner debuts.
primary.imgAlt: Family slope at Asahi Prime — compact runs and Mt. Asama foothill views

secondary.title: 22 snow guns beat mild winters
secondary.lead: Base elevation 900 m is offset by 22 snow machines including DEMACLENKO units — reliable openings even in low-snow seasons so families can plan with confidence.

pass.title:
Pricing built
for families
pass.lead: Adult day ticket ¥4,600; child (ages 3–elementary) ¥3,100. One adult + one child family day ticket ¥7,500 — strong value for family day trips.
pass.noticeBody: Lead with highly rated school lessons and free morning classes — bold family LP hooks like satisfaction guarantees for first-timers (report ch.7).
pass.imgAlt: Family enjoying Asahi Prime — kids park and gentle slopes

rental.title:
Rent next door,
debut same day.
rental.lead: Cartet Hall bundles ticket counter, restaurant, and shop; rental building is right beside it — wear, skis, boards, and DJI action camera rental for memorable first runs. Families can debut the same day they arrive.
rental.whisper: Karamatsu log cottages allow pets — pairs with green-season camping for year-round stays.
rental.imgAlt: Family picking up rental gear — hands-free ski debut

yukinko.title:
Night lights for
after-work snow play.
yukinko.lead: Night skiing on a compact hill — leverage proximity to Matsumoto and Shiojiri for half-day plus night plans (report proposal).
yukinko.whisper: Gentle lit slopes suit first night runs — low crowds at a local hill add peace of mind.
yukinko.imgAlt: Asahi Prime slopes under night lights — evening family skiing

family.title:
First time on skis,
patient coaching.
family.lead: Kids sled park in front of the lodge, 8° average Family run, Lift 2 with mid-station exit — highly rated private lessons and free beginner classes so many families ski together by afternoon.
family.noticeBody: Two-hour lessons often lead to afternoon family runs together — coaches teach basics like sock length and hats that beginners overlook (review insights).
family.imgAlt: Children sledding in kids park — visible from the lodge for safety

spa.title:
After skiing,
soba and hot spring.
spa.lead: Moegino soba for touji soba lunch, Asahi Craft Center for chopstick making — finish at Ringo no Yu Obu in Matsumoto or Shinshu Kenko Land in Shiojiri. A classic Asahi–Matsumoto area loop.
spa.whisper: Micro-tourism pass concepts bundle lift tickets with village café and craft discounts (report ch.7).
spa.imgAlt: Shinshu soba and hot spring — après-ski loop in Asahi and Matsumoto

workation.title:
First-timer's
Shinshu 1-day trip.
workation.lead: Ski debut at Asahi Prime → touji soba at Moegino → chopsticks at Craft Center → Ringo no Yu Obu on the way home. Official model course to turn a short ski stop into area-wide spending (report ch.5).

04.title: Ringo no Yu Obu
04.body: Carbonated baths and sauna in Matsumoto

05.title: Return via Shiojiri IC
05.body: Lower-snow roads for a safer drive home

local.title: Near Shiojiri IC · family debut guide
local.body: Under half the price of mega resorts · low crowds · hard to get lost — win the beginner debut battle as the closest hill to Matsumoto and Shiojiri with photo access guides and live ops (report ch.7).

schools.title: Micro-tourism pass concept
schools.body: Bundle lift tickets with village café and craft discounts — a quick win to extend stays and lift spend per visit (report ch.7).

summer.title: Nomata camp & year-round play
summer.body: Nomata forest camp, log cottages, summer water-gun battles and stargazing — cross-sell winter guests to summer and vice versa (report ch.6).
